name: Nightly Commitizen & Changelog Check

on:
  schedule:
    # Run at 00:00 UTC every day
    - cron: "0 0 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  check-commitizen-config:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.10"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install commitizen pre-commit

      - name: Verify commitizen configuration
        run: |
          # Check if pyproject.toml exists and has commitizen config
          if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then
            if grep -q "\[tool.commitizen\]" pyproject.toml; then
              echo "Commitizen configuration found in pyproject.toml"
              cz version
            else
              echo "::warning::No [tool.commitizen] section found in pyproject.toml"
              exit 1
            fi
          else
            echo "::error::pyproject.toml not found"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Verify pre-commit configuration
        run: |
          if [ -f .pre-commit-config.yaml ]; then
            if grep -q "commitizen" .pre-commit-config.yaml; then
              echo "Commitizen pre-commit hook configured"
            else
              echo "::warning::Commitizen hook not found in .pre-commit-config.yaml"
            fi
          else
            echo "::warning::.pre-commit-config.yaml not found"
          fi

      - name: Check CHANGELOG.md exists
        run: |
          if [ -f CHANGELOG.md ]; then
            echo "CHANGELOG.md exists"
            # Check if it has conventional commit style entries
            if grep -q "^## \[" CHANGELOG.md || grep -q "^## " CHANGELOG.md; then
              echo "CHANGELOG.md appears to have versioned entries"
            else
              echo "::warning::CHANGELOG.md may not follow standard versioning format"
            fi
          else
            echo "::warning::CHANGELOG.md not found"
          fi

      - name: Validate recent commits format (dry run)
        run: |
          # Check last 10 commits for conventional commit format
          echo "Checking recent commits for conventional commit format..."
          git log --format="%s" -10 | while read -r commit_msg; do
            if echo "$commit_msg" | grep -qE "^(feat|fix|docs|style|refactor|perf|test|build|ci|chore|revert)(\(.+\))?: .+"; then
              echo "✓ Valid: $commit_msg"
            else
              echo "✗ Invalid: $commit_msg"
            fi
          done
